cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, sys, random, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import gen as G
rng = random.Random(11)
req = G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=12, pathlen=4, cap=3, equal=True)
line = json.dumps(req)+'\n'
open('/workspace/tmp/req.json','w').write(line)
code = '''
import json,sys
req=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/req.json'))
flows=req['flows']; offers=req['offers']; warmup=req['warmup']
ben=[]
for f in flows:
    kinds=f['kinds']; tmpl=bytes.fromhex(f['template']); H=len(tmpl); nd=kinds.count('D'); N=len(f['path']); h=N-1
    per=(H-4-nd)*N
    q=kinds.index('Q'); t=kinds.index('T')
    elig=0; cum=0
    for run in offers[f['id']]:
        hdr=bytes.fromhex(run['header'])
        good=all(kinds[i]!='K' or hdr[i]==tmpl[i] for i in range(H)) and hdr[q]<=7 and hdr[t]>h
        if good:
            end=cum+run['count']
            if end>warmup: elig += end-max(cum,warmup)
        cum+=run['count']
    ben.append(per*elig)
print(ben)
'''
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c',code],capture_output=True,text=True)
